texts.NIV84: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have struck hands in pledge for another,
texts.KJV: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
texts.NKJV:
My son, if you become surety for your friend,
If you have shaken hands in pledge for a stranger,
texts.DRB: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, thou hast engaged fast thy hand to a stranger.

texts.NIV84: if you have been trapped by what you said, ensnared by the words of your mouth,
texts.KJV: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
texts.NKJV:
You are snared by the words of your mouth;
You are taken by the words of your mouth.
texts.DRB: Thou art ensnared with the words of thy mouth, and caught with thy own words.

texts.NIV84: then do this, my son, to free yourself, since you have fallen into your neighbor's hands: Go and humble yourself; press your plea with your neighbor!
texts.KJV: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
texts.DRB: Do therefore, my son, what I say, and deliver thyself: because thou art fallen into the hand of thy neighbour. Run about, make haste, stir up thy friend:

texts.NIV84: Allow no sleep to your eyes, no slumber to your eyelids.
texts.KJV: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
texts.NKJV:
Give no sleep to your eyes,
Nor slumber to your eyelids.
texts.DRB: Give not sleep to thy eyes, neither let thy eyelids slumber.

texts.NIV84: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
texts.KJV: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
texts.NKJV:
Deliver yourself like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter,
And like a bird from the hand of the fowler.
texts.DRB: Deliver thyself as a doe from the hand, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

texts.NIV84: Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!
texts.KJV: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
texts.NKJV:
Go to the ant, you sluggard!
Consider her ways and be wise,
texts.DRB: Go to the ant, O sluggard, and consider her ways, and learn wisdom:

texts.NIV84: It has no commander, no overseer or ruler,
texts.KJV: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
texts.NKJV:
Which, having no captain,
Overseer or ruler,
texts.DRB: Which, although she hath no guide, nor master, nor captain,

texts.NIV84: yet it stores its provisions in summer and gathers its food at harvest.
texts.KJV: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
texts.NKJV:
Provides her supplies in the summer,
And gathers her food in the harvest.
texts.DRB: Provideth her meat for herself in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

texts.NIV84: How long will you lie there, you sluggard? When will you get up from your sleep?
texts.KJV: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
texts.NKJV:
How long will you slumber, O sluggard?
When will you rise from your sleep?
texts.DRB: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou rise out of thy sleep?

texts.NIV84: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest-
texts.KJV: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
texts.NKJV:
A little sleep, a little slumber,
A little folding of the hands to sleep—
texts.DRB: Thou wilt sleep a little, thou wilt slumber a little, thou wilt fold thy hands a little to sleep:

texts.NIV84: and poverty will come on you like a bandit and scarcity like an armed man.
texts.KJV: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
texts.NKJV:
So shall your poverty come on you like a prowler,
And your need like an armed man.
texts.DRB: And want shall come upon thee, as a traveller, and poverty as a man armed. But if thou be diligent, thy harvest shall come as a fountain, and want shall flee far from thee.

texts.NIV84: A scoundrel and villain, who goes about with a corrupt mouth,
texts.KJV: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
texts.NKJV:
A worthless person, a wicked man,
Walks with a perverse mouth;
texts.DRB: A man that is an apostate, an unprofitable man, walketh with a perverse mouth,

texts.NIV84: who winks with his eye, signals with his feet and motions with his fingers,
texts.KJV: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
texts.DRB: He winketh with the eyes, presseth with the foot, speaketh with the finger.

texts.NIV84: who plots evil with deceit in his heart- he always stirs up dissension.
texts.KJV: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
texts.NKJV:
Perversity is in his heart,
He devises evil continually,
He sows discord.
texts.DRB: With a wicked heart he deviseth evil, and at all times he soweth discord.

texts.NIV84: Therefore disaster will overtake him in an instant; he will suddenly be destroyed-without remedy.
texts.KJV: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
texts.NKJV:
Therefore his calamity shall come suddenly;
Suddenly he shall be broken without remedy.
texts.DRB: To such a one his destruction shall presently come, and he shall suddenly be destroyed, and shall no longer have any remedy.

texts.NIV84: There are six things the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to him:
texts.KJV: These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
texts.NKJV:
These six things the Lord hates,
Yes, seven are an abomination to Him:
texts.DRB: Six things there are, which the Lord hateth, and the seventh his soul detesteth:

texts.NIV84: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
texts.KJV: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
texts.NKJV:
A proud look,
A lying tongue,
Hands that shed innocent blood,
texts.DRB: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

texts.NIV84: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are quick to rush into evil,
texts.KJV: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
texts.NKJV:
A heart that devises wicked plans,
Feet that are swift in running to evil,
texts.DRB: A heart that deviseth wicked plots, feet that are swift to run into mischief,

texts.NIV84: a false witness who pours out lies and a man who stirs up dissension among brothers.
texts.KJV: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
texts.NKJV:
A false witness who speaks lies,
And one who sows discord among brethren.
texts.DRB: A deceitful witness that uttereth lies, and him that soweth discord among brethren.

blocks.title: Bind the Law & Command Upon Your Heart

texts.NIV84: My son, keep your father's commands and do not forsake your mother's teaching.
texts.KJV: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
texts.NKJV:
My son, keep your father’s command,
And do not forsake the law of your mother.
texts.DRB: My son, keep the commandments of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother.

texts.NIV84: Bind them upon your heart forever; fasten them around your neck.
texts.KJV: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
texts.NKJV:
Bind them continually upon your heart;
Tie them around your neck.
texts.DRB: Bind them in thy heart continually, and put them about thy neck.

texts.NIV84: When you walk, they will guide you; when you sleep, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.
texts.KJV: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
texts.DRB: When thou walkest, let them go with thee: when thou sleepest, let them keep thee; and when thou awakest, talk with them.

texts.NIV84: For these commands are a lamp, this teaching is a light, and the corrections of discipline are the way to life,
texts.KJV: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
texts.DRB: Because the commandment is a lamp, and the law a light, and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

texts.NIV84: keeping you from the immoral woman, from the smooth tongue of the wayward wife.
texts.KJV: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
texts.NKJV:
To keep you from the evil woman,
From the flattering tongue of a seductress.
texts.DRB: That they may keep thee from the evil woman, and from the flattering tongue of the stranger.

texts.NIV84: Do not lust in your heart after her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes,
texts.KJV: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
texts.NKJV:
Do not lust after her beauty in your heart,
Nor let her allure you with her eyelids.
texts.DRB: Let not thy heart covet her beauty, be not caught with her winks:

texts.NIV84: for the prostitute reduces you to a loaf of bread, and the adulteress preys upon your very life.
texts.KJV: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adultress will hunt for the precious life.
texts.DRB: For the price of a harlot is scarce one loaf: but the woman catcheth the precious soul of a man.

texts.NIV84: Can a man scoop fire into his lap without his clothes being burned?
texts.KJV: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
texts.NKJV:
Can a man take fire to his bosom,
And his clothes not be burned?
texts.DRB: Can a man hide fire in his bosom, and his garments not burn?

texts.NIV84: Can a man walk on hot coals without his feet being scorched?
texts.KJV: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
texts.NKJV:
Can one walk on hot coals,
And his feet not be seared?
texts.DRB: Or can he walk upon hot coals, and his feet not be burnt?

texts.NIV84: So is he who sleeps with another man's wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.
texts.KJV: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
texts.NKJV:
So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife;
Whoever touches her shall not be innocent.
texts.DRB: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife, shall not be clean when he shall touch her.

texts.NIV84: Men do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger when he is starving.
texts.KJV: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
texts.NKJV:
People do not despise a thief
If he steals to satisfy himself when he is starving.
texts.DRB: The fault is not so great when a man hath stolen: for he stealeth to fill his hungry soul:

texts.NIV84: Yet if he is caught, he must pay sevenfold, though it costs him all the wealth of his house.
texts.KJV: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
texts.NKJV:
Yet when he is found, he must restore sevenfold;
He may have to give up all the substance of his house.
texts.DRB: And if he be taken he shall restore sevenfold, and shall give up all the substance of his house.

texts.NIV84: But a man who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.
texts.KJV: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
texts.NKJV:
Whoever commits adultery with a woman lacks understanding;
He who does so destroys his own soul.
texts.DRB: But he that is an adulterer, for the folly of his heart shall destroy his own soul:

texts.NIV84: Blows and disgrace are his lot, and his shame will never be wiped away;
texts.KJV: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
texts.NKJV:
Wounds and dishonor he will get,
And his reproach will not be wiped away.
texts.DRB: He gathereth to himself shame and dishonour, and his reproach shall not be blotted out:

texts.NIV84: for jealousy arouses a husband's fury, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.
texts.KJV: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
texts.NKJV:
For jealousy is a husband’s fury;
Therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
texts.DRB: Because the jealousy and rage of the husband will not spare in the day of revenge,

texts.NIV84: He will not accept any compensation; he will refuse the bribe, however great it is.
texts.KJV: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
texts.NKJV:
He will accept no recompense,
Nor will he be appeased though you give many gifts.
texts.DRB: Nor will he yield to any man's prayers, nor will he accept for satisfaction ever so many gifts.
